krismm_hud_desc: Configure position and appearance of the music banner.
krismm_queue_desc: Queue up songs to play during upcoming assault waves.
krismm_skip_track_desc: Immediately skip to the next track.
shuffle_play_no_repeat_desc: Prevents tracks from repeating until all allowed tracks have played.
shuffle_play_frequency_desc: Change track every X assault waves.
shuffle_play_track_desc: Toggle whether this track can play randomly.
krismm_queue_track_desc: Click to add this track to the play queue.
shuffle_play_enable_all_desc: Enable all tracks in this category.
shuffle_play_disable_all_desc: Disable all tracks in this category.
krismm_toggle_shuffle_desc: Turn Shuffle Play mod on or off immediately.
krismm_show_banner_desc: Shows an Assault-style banner when the music changes.
krismm_banner_align_desc: Moves the music banner to the right side of the screen and flips icon placement.
krismm_banner_uppercase_desc: Displays banner text and song names in all uppercase letters.
krismm_banner_x_desc: Move the banner left or right.
krismm_banner_y_desc: Move the banner up or down.
krismm_banner_hue_desc: Adjust the hue of the music banner.
krismm_banner_sat_desc: Adjust the color intensity of the music banner.
krismm_previous_track_desc: Replay the previously played track in case you skipped it by mistake.
